what: The one list the /workshop/ page draws itself from. Every area is a branch, every entry a leaf. A lane that ships a page appends one leaf here (node scripts/workshop-add.mjs) and the page is current; nobody edits workshop/index.html by hand.

statuses.live: on the Hub or the Station now, on real data
statuses.preview: a trial copy at its own address; the live page is unchanged
statuses.read: a write-up or report to read
statuses.proposal: a design proposal to look at; nothing built into the Hub yet
statuses.decision: waiting on Alan's call; the ask says what
statuses.building: a lane is on it now; lands here when it returns
statuses.corrected: a report that carries a correction at the top
statuses.archive: replaced by a newer page; kept for the record

items.title: Comps · one company · football field
items.blurb: Each valuation measure a bar of the peers' range; dashed line = today's price; the overlap = fair value. CapEx section. Type any ticker.

items.title: Company view round 2 · try it
items.blurb: The Station chart always on top with the clouds and one RSI pane, your ladder of averages back (all nine), six key numbers, EXPAND with a name rail, arrow keys between names. A trial copy; the live Hub is unchanged until you say so.

items.title: Geiger: start at 3h, count 4h + 6h once
items.blurb: The review recommends yes to both: the measured effect is tiny and it matches the Lab's RSI from 3h up. Your Equalizer, your call.

items.title: Comps: a saved peer list per company
items.blurb: AI POWERTRAIN is a theme, not a peer group (turbines next to uranium and fuel cells). Recommend one saved peer list per company before aggregating.
